input.free_text_description: The system operates in the microservices infrastructure, authentication domain. It serves API Consumer, Customer, User as its primary actors. The main business capabilities include thrift, async greeting, greeting message. The system enforces access control and identity verification for protected operations.

As a API Consumer, I want to create and browse posts, so that I can share content and discover what others have published.
As a API Consumer, I want to manage thrift operations, so that the relevant business process is handled efficiently.
As a API Consumer, I want to interact with async greeting functionality, so that the system fulfills my needs.
As a API Consumer, I want to interact with greeting message functionality, so that the system fulfills my needs.
